disclaimer: Indicative reference data, not tax advice. Figures reflect HMRC appropriate-percentage policy announced to 2029/30 and the Autumn Budget 2025 eVED measure. Verify against HMRC guidance before relying on these figures.
description: Electric Vehicle Excise Duty (eVED), the pay-per-mile charge announced at Autumn Budget 2025 and applying from April 2028.
notes: Battery electric vehicles pay 3p per mile; plug-in hybrids pay 1.5p per mile.
Conventional hybrids, petrol and diesel vehicles are not subject to eVED.
eVED is separate from company car tax and is charged on miles driven, not on the P11D value.
